ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a single straight horizontal line segment with marked points ordered from left to right as A, N, C, M, B. Thus N, C, and M all lie between A and B, and N and M are on the same side of A, so MN can be found as the difference between their distances from A. Reasoning: Since AB = 12 and M is the midpoint of AB, AM = 12 ÷ 2 = 6. Since AC = 4 and N is the midpoint of AC, AN = 4 ÷ 2 = 2. Therefore MN = AM − AN = 6 − 2 = 4.
